overview: White throws the g-pawn forward with 2.g4 against Black's knight, offering a pawn for rapid development and the h-file. After 2...Nxg4 White plays 3.e4 or 3.f3 to harass the knight and take the centre; Black can keep the pawn but has to survive tricks. The gambit is rare and generally considered unsound.

white_ideas.idea: Gain time against the g4 knight with e4 or f3
Open lines with Bg2 or h3

black_ideas.idea: Take the pawn and retreat with ...Nf6
Counter in the centre with ...d6 and ...e5

typical_structures.structure: White centre pawns on d4/e4 against a Black king-pawn defence with the g-file open

character.notes: A speculative gambit with tactics and traps.

gambit.notes: A pawn is offered that the opponent can keep.

soundness.notes: Dubious for White; Black keeps the pawn with accurate play.

sublines_that_differ.name: Oshima Defense
sublines_that_differ.how: Black declines with a counter-strike in the centre.
